persos.desc: man in his 30s, peach-and-burgundy tracksuit, short dreadlocks, empty hands
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left, pointing at the phone, furious

persos.desc: phone seller man in his 30s, turquoise-and-copper t-shirt, thin beard, empty hands
persos.pose: standing behind the display on the right, arms crossed, calm

dialogue: Mon vieux, ce téléphone-là, c'est mon téléphone qu'on a volé hier !
Ya fohi, mon frère. Pour toi, prix spécial ancien propriétaire.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The customer shouts his line, pointing at the phone, face turned three-quarters to the camera. The seller stays perfectly calm, uncrosses his arms, opens one hand like a generous merchant and says his line, his face clearly visible.
chute: The customer freezes, his finger still pointing, mouth open. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the robbed customer's speechless face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE MONSIEUR EN SORTANT SON PORTEFEUILLE :
mecanisme: logique commerciale absurde (remise de fidélité pour la victime)
